Critics Consensus Dark's central mystery unfolds slowly, both tense and terrifying, culminating in a creepy, cinematic triumph of sci-fi noir. Read Critics Reviews Sean T. Collins Decider 06/21/2018 Dark feels like a version of Lost folded in on itself, in which the action on the magical, spacetime-traveling Island and the secret-revealing, surprise-laden, character-driven backstory flashbacks all occur simultaneously. Go to Full Review Brad Newsome Sydney Morning Herald 03/29/2018 If Stranger Things is a big bowl of macaroni and cheese made with that lurid orange cheddar you can only get in America, Dark is a gamy Old World stew ladled out from a pot that has been bubbling away for centuries. Go to Full Review John Doyle Globe and Mail 12/07/2017 What sets Dark apart and raises it to the level of truly fine drama is its quietness and beauty. Go to Full Review Morgan Olson Loud and Clear Reviews 01/08/2025 Dark’s creators Baran bo Odar and Jantje Friese’s have crafted a remarkable, labyrinthian series of interconnected characters, events, and consequences. Go to Full Review Rafael Sánchez Casademont Fotogramas 06/24/2024 A difficult series, perhaps the closest anything has come to 'Lost', without being a cheap copy of 'Lost'... Go to Full Review Jennifer Bisset CNET 04/06/2023 The OA is still the second-best TV show sunk into the mines of Netflix. We believe the best show is German sci-fi thriller Dark... Go to Full Review Read all reviews Robert M @fantastic-adventures Mar 15 Superb. Best time travel story ever. I love the story, casting, production and intrigue. Had me guessing for most of the show and very intelligent, relatable story. I was fascinated, which rarely happens to me. The fact that it was a German production added to the mysterious curiosity. See more TAYLOR F. @taterfan Mar 2 A masterpiece. My favorite Netflix show of all time! Blake S @ElongatedMusket Feb 28 Created this account just to say this series is a masterpiece. Chris H @RT32911948 Feb 1 Absolutely hooked from minute one. Such a complicated story extremely well done. Danielle R @Witchydrichy Jan 27 One of the most intriguing and original shows in the past 10 years. I recommend this show to everyone, first season is a masterpiece. The dubbing is superb, once the plot hooked me, it was hard to notice that the actors and dubbed words are not from the original takes. See more K. E @SysComp Jan 24 An absolute masterpiece in each and every way imaginable.
